data.name: Harald
data.long_meaning: Hari (army) + wald (rule). This Old Norse name means 'rule with the army'. The name Harald was common among Scandinavian and Germanic rulers. It was also used by several saints.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace leadership and courage in your spiritual journey.

in_hebrew.name: הארלד
in_hebrew.meaning: שליט צבאי, מנהיג חזק, או שומר נאמן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: הארלד הוא שם שמקורו בשפות הצפוניות, אך יש לו השפעה והתייחסות גם בשפה העברית ובמסורת הנוצרית. משמעותו קשורה להיותו שליט צבאי, מנהיג חזק, או שומר נאמן. הארלד הוא שם שמשדר כוח, נחישות והגנה. במסורת הנוצרית, השם הארלד אינו מופיע ישירות בכתבי הקודש, אך הוא קשור לערכים של מנהיגות, הגנה ואמונה.

in_greek.name: Χάραλδ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χάραλδ, αν και προέρχεται από τις σκανδιναβικές γλώσσες, έχει απήχηση και στη χριστιανική παράδοση. Η ετυμολογία του συνδέεται με την έννοια του ισχυρού ηγέτη, του στρατιωτικού διοικητή. Στην πρώιμη χριστιανική εκκλησία, το όνομα αυτό δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα στις Γραφές, αλλά συμβολίζει την ηγετική θέση, τη δύναμη και την προστασία, αξίες που είναι θεμελιώδεις στη χριστιανική διδασκαλία.

in_latin.name: Harald
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Harald, origine ex linguis septentrionalibus, tamen in traditione christiana significationem habet. Dux fortis, princeps potens, seu custos fidelis interpretatur. In ecclesia christiana primitiva, nomen hoc non invenitur directe in Scripturis, sed significat ductio, fortitudo et protectio, quae sunt fundamentum doctrinae christianae.

in_english.name: Harald
in_english.meaning: Strong ruler, military leader, or guardian
in_english.long_meaning: The name Harald, originating from Old Norse, carries the meaning of a strong ruler, military leader, or guardian. Derived from the Old Norse words 'har' meaning 'army' and 'valdr' meaning 'ruler' or 'leader', Harald signifies strength, leadership, and protection. While not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name Harald reflects Christian values of leadership, courage, and guardianship. Historically, several saints and rulers have borne this name, contributing to its significance in Christian tradition.

biblical_reference.note: The name Harald does not appear directly in the Bible.

data.cultural_impact: Harald was a common name among the Scandinavian and Germanic rulers, who ruled their lands with military might. The name evokes a sense of strength, leadership, and power. Harald the Fairhaired, who ruled Norway from 872 to 933 AD, is an excellent example of a legendary ruler with this name.
data.spiritual_significance: Despite its military connotations, Harald also carries spiritual significance. Harald the Fairhaired, aside from being a powerful ruler, was also a patron saint of Norway. He was said to have converted Norway to Christianity and blessed the country with peace. In this way, Harald's name represents a fusion of power and faith, symbolizing a leader who rules not only with military might but also with spiritual guidance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Thomas Harald in London, United Kingdom credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Harald, which means "Rule with the army". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
